title: Book Three · Chapter 136: A Note for a Customer
story:
Ronan reaches the training centre before two on Sunday.

He has paid one yuan for the bus. The other coin stays in his pocket for home.

A woman at the door shows him the visitor room. There are tables, paper, and a few examples of class work on the wall.

Ronan sits beside an older student. She has come from a food shop. She wants to write clearer messages for the morning workers.

The first activity begins with a short note.

Your order will be ready tomorrow. Please come in the afternoon.

“What does the customer need?” the teacher asks.

Someone says the shop name. The older student asks which order.

Ronan looks at the word tomorrow.

“When did we write it?”

The teacher puts the same note beside two different dates. Ronan can see the problem at once.

They try a new version. It gives the customer's name, the order, a date, and a time after two.

The teacher asks them to keep the sentences short. Ronan writes his version and passes it to the student beside him.

She points to one line.

“Can I come at six?”

Ronan looks at the sample shop hours. The shop closes at five.

He adds before five. Then he reads her message about a food delivery. He can find the date and the morning time without help.

For the second activity, they ask each other about an order. Ronan plays the customer first. Then he answers the questions himself.

He speaks too quickly once. The older student lifts a hand.

“One thing at a time.”

He starts again. This time, she can write the whole size before he gives the next one.

Afterward, Ronan asks the teacher about regular lessons.

“There are written tasks and number work too,” she says. “Talking is only part.”

He looks at the examples on the wall. One page has a short letter. Another has rows of prices and totals.

He copies the centre's address for further information. He wants the class times and fees before he chooses anything.

At four, he leaves with his practice note. He pays the second yuan on the bus home.

Twenty-one remains from his wages. There is no new pay for the afternoon.

At the green door, he finds Dad beside the kitchen window. Ronan takes out the note and shows him the changed date and time.

Dad reads it, then points to before five.

“Time to get home for dinner.”

Ronan laughs and follows him into the yard.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

version＝版本、改写的一种写法；delivery＝送货；regular lessons＝正式持续开的课程；fee＝费用。

## 理解问题

1. 原便条的tomorrow和in the afternoon为什么不够清楚？Ronan实际加上哪些信息？
2. 他有没有因此报名或领到新工资？往返后工资信封余多少？

## 读句子

**Talking is only part.**

拆开看：Talking / is / only part.

与人交谈／是／其中一部分。
